About
The Kalahari Game Lodge (KGL) is a luxury private game ranch situated next to the Kgalagadi Transfrontier Park on the south-eastern boarder of Namibia. This oasis surrounded by red sand is a mere 18 km west of the newly opened Mata-Mata border post, making it easily accessible for not only visitors in Namibia, but also those visiting South Africa. The KGL has eight luxury chalets with beautiful views of the Auob river. For the more adventurous, there are six secluded campsites in the Auob riverbed.

Kalahari Game Lodge Accommodation
Luxury Chalets
The lodge comprises of eight luxury chalets equipped with en-suite bathrooms, ceiling fans, air-cons and mosquito nets. The small kitchenette has tea and coffee making facility, wash basin, small fridge and a seating area. Each chalet also boasts with a private patio with idyllic views of the tranquil surroundings. At the lodge, guests can enjoy the restaurant, swimming pool, bonfire pit, and bar facilities.
Campsites
For the more adventurous visitors, the lodge also has six exclusive campsites located in the picturesque Auob riverbed. These campsites are widely spread and approximately 100 meters apart. Each is equipped with private ablution facilities, lighted by solar energy (advised to also bring own additional lighting) and the water heating system is a wood-fired donkey boiler. Housekeeping attends to each campsite daily.
The campsites can accommodate up to four people comfortably, but larger groups travelling together can be accommodated in more than one campsite next to each other. Please note that there are no electricity outlets available at the campsites. Fridges and other equipment can be charged at the main lodge area, please enquire at reception for more details.

Facilities
Restaurant
The Kalahari Game Lodge has a beautiful, fully licensed restaurant where chalet guests can enjoy breakfast and dinner. Please specify any dietary requirement upon booking to ensure that all your needs are catered for.
Braai Facilities
Two chalets share a boma area that guests are welcome to use for making a relaxing fire at night or to prepare their own meals. Campsites also have braai facilities. To be self-catering at the chalet or campsites guests need to bring along their own equipment, utensils and food items as they are not provided by the lodge.
Swimming Pool
The swimming pool is located at the lodge and available to chalet and campsite guests.
WiFi
Free wifi at reception area only, just ask your host for details.

Reaching the Kalahari Game Lodge
BORDER POSTS
For visitors travelling from South Africa, the Kalahari Game Lodge is accessible from four border posts – Noordoewer/Vioolsdrift, Rietfontein/Klein Menassa, Nakop/Ariamsvlei and Mata-Mata at the Kgalagadi Transfrontier Park, a mere 18 km from the lodge. Please familiarise yourself with all Kgalagadi Transfrontier Park rules and regulations should the park be accessed as no cross-border drive through is allowed without a required minimum 2-night stay inside the park – www.sanparks.org
ROADS
Most of the roads in Namibia are well-maintained gravel roads. In the summer months, excessive rains might result in some exciting driving experiences. We recommend the use of 4×4 vehicles for travelling on gravel roads. Feel free to contact us for updates on road conditions and general enquiries.
